verdict.rationale: Postman's docs only say that users who are not signed in can still send multi-protocol requests through a 'lightweight API client' (postman-docs-34, postman-docs-53). Workspaces are documented as collaborative team spaces (postman-docs-18, postman-docs-21). Community reports say the app has grown more restrictive for non-logged-in users and needs cloud connectivity (postman-comm-1, postman-comm-3, postman-comm-4), which supports the limited scope rather than contradicting a vendor claim. Missing for 10: a documented local or offline workspace, saving collections and environments without an account, full feature parity offline, and independent confirmation of offline operation.
